summary: Expanded the universe around nuclear-grade manufacturing and advanced-fuel fabrication rather than reactor developers alone. The cleanest public exposures found in this pass are BWXT and newly public X-energy for advanced fuel/component capability, with Curtiss-Wright and Mirion as more underfollowed second-order suppliers tied to reactor coolant pumps, control-rod mechanisms, nuclear instrumentation, radiation monitoring, inspection, and compliance hardware.
